title: Yardeni：5.25%未必是收益率顶部 债市重定价加速
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Does this mean that at this point, if something might break or there are signs that at least the broader risk appetite is waning, or at a pretty accelerating clip, does that make
segments.zh: 这是否意味着，如果某些环节可能承压，或者至少整体风险偏好在减弱，甚至速度在加快，这是否让你

segments.en: you bullish bonds? We heard from Jim Bianco yesterday that he is getting bullish for the first time in years just based on this technical retracement.
segments.zh: 看多债券？昨天比安科说，他多年来首次转向看多，就是基于这种技术性回撤。

segments.en: I would say that bonds yielding 5.25 percent are very attractive, certainly on a ten-year basis.
segments.zh: 我会说，收益率在5.25%的债券非常有吸引力，尤其是十年期。

segments.en: The good thing about bonds is if you just hold them, you get your money back and you get the yield.
segments.zh: 债券的好处是，只要持有，就能拿回本金并获得收益。

segments.en: I think, again, 5.25 is a pretty good yield, but it doesn't feel like this is necessarily the peak in bond yields.
segments.zh: 我认为，5.25%确实是不错的收益率，但感觉这未必是债券收益率的峰值。

segments.en: I think even Bianco said that we might find that we can get even better yields if we just
segments.zh: 我想连Bianco也说过，我们可能会发现，如果只是

segments.en: kind of wait here. So I'm not convinced that 5.25 percent is necessarily the top in yields.
segments.zh: 在这里等待，就能获得更好的收益率。所以我不确信5.25%一定是收益率的顶部。

segments.en: I was thinking that that was the case, but I'm increasingly wondering whether the unwind of the yield curve trade is a big problem here.
segments.zh: 我之前以为是这样，但我越来越怀疑，收益率曲线交易的平仓是不是一个大问题。

segments.en: This kind of, I just recently wrote actually last night that this might be the revenge of the bond vigilantes.
segments.zh: 这种，我昨晚刚写道，这可能是债券义警的复仇。

segments.en: The bond vigilantes were suppressed from the great financial crisis to the great virus crisis.
segments.zh: 债券义警从大流动性变化到大疫情危机期间一直被压制。
